title: Nvidia signs multi-billion optics purchase commitment with Coherent

sources.quote: The non-exclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multi-billion-dollar purchase commitment and future access and capacity rights for advanced laser and optical networking products.

explain: Alongside its $2 billion investment, Nvidia committed to buy lasers and optical networking products from Coherent over several years. The deal was described only as multi-billion-dollar, so no exact amount is recorded.
